title: Can You Remember 15 Synonyms for PROBLEM? (Memory Challenge)
description:
Ten words for PROBLEM in a plain list, then one silly story. How many can you remember each time? Grab a pen: you get two scores.

1. Watch the list, then pause the video and write down every word you remember. That's your list score.
2. Watch the story, then pause again and write down every word you can recall, in order. That's your story score.
3. Stay for the surprise at the end, and the whole PROBLEM ladder on one screen.
4. Comment your two scores: list versus story.

The story goes roughly from small problems to very serious ones: hiccup, snag, hitch, glitch, issue, difficulty, obstacle, complication, setback, headache, trouble, dilemma, predicament, crisis, disaster. For each word, you learn what it means, for example: a problem that causes a short delay ("a hitch", and "without a hitch" means with no problems at all), a small fault in a machine or computer ("a glitch"), something in your way ("an obstacle"), a very difficult choice, often between two things ("a dilemma"), and a difficult situation that is hard to get out of ("a predicament"). You also learn which one is informal ("snag"), and what "in trouble" means.

Tonight, try it with your own new words: one silly story, one picture for each word.

For more words, look up "another word for problem" on anotherwordfor.net: https://anotherwordfor.net/another-word-for-problem/
